Subject: Corthan Grill Holdings - Referral Required

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the submission on Corthan Grill Holdings. I've reviewed the information and appreciate how complete it is.

Unfortunately, this risk requires referral to our senior underwriting team due to a couple of factors:

- Two locations are within 16 km of the coast
- Our existing coastal accumulation within 25 km is already high, which limits our capacity in this area

Given these constraints, this may fall outside our standard appetite. I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty coastal property market, as they focus on these exposures and can likely provide more competitive terms.

Happy to discuss if you have questions, but wanted to give you a quick response so you can explore other options.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
